items.lede: Many (if not all) Xbox Series X and Xbox One games are supported.
items.title: Xbox's disc-to-digital feature is now available for everyone

items.lede: Xbox gamers can now get a digital license tied to their physical game discs associated with their Xbox profile for select titles, allowing them to play the game without needing to insert it into the console.
items.title: Xbox Disc to Digital feature rolls out to all Xbox players to enable playing disc-free, but selling your media revokes access
